title: PPA - https://launchpad.net/~mitchdz/+archive/ubuntu/mpath-dmsetup
description:
PPA - https://launchpad.net/~mitchdz/+archive/ubuntu/mpath-dmsetup

This reverts the downgrade for dmsetup. This was in-place because lvm2 was not updated in our archives, so we decided to keep the delta that debian dropped. This change removes that delta, bringing us in-line with Debian.

This is functionally the same as https://salsa.debian.org/linux-blocks-team/multipath-tools/-/commit/902a13b2c628d2cfde74cb78fd1ba4425af3d7d4
